rfis.question: Please confirm the scope by priority as marked on the plan: green (kitchens 108 and 201, men's washrooms 102 and 203), orange (tile in entrance, corridors, control room 105, stair), blue (second floor corridors, conference 205, offices 206 to 211).
The women's washroom 202 is not marked. Is it in scope?
Floor finishes: what product for the kitchens and the Priority 3 offices and corridors (sheet vinyl, VCT, LVP or carpet tile)? Floor and wall tile selection and size?
Is the 4 ft wall tile wainscot replaced with new tile at the same height, or removed and the walls finished and painted?
Toilet partitions: replace, and in what material (powder-coated steel, plastic laminate, solid plastic)?
Washroom 2 drawing shows two toilets; the photo shows one urinal and one toilet. Which is right, and what fixtures are wanted?
Plumbing fixtures and washroom accessories: does Air Liquide supply them, or does Steadfast? Any models or standards to match?
Kitchen 108: are the oak cabinets and tall pantry included, and do new cabinets need to match the white plastic laminate? Countertop material, backsplash, sink and faucet?
Ceiling heights in each room, and do the T-bar ceilings and lights stay as they are?
Stairs: what does "tile" mean on the steel stair, new rubber treads and risers, or the landings only?
Is there a hazardous materials report for the building? One is needed before demolition.
Site rules: safety orientation, contractor prequalification, working hours, and can one men's washroom stay open while the other is done?
Bid due date, bid form, contract form, insurance and any bonding?
Are any electrical or ventilation changes wanted (washroom lights, exhaust fans, kitchen outlets)? Currently excluded.
Who pulls the building permit, and is one needed?

exclusions: Electrical, lighting and ventilation work unless listed
assumptions: Building stays occupied; one men's washroom kept open at a time
Wall tile wainscot 4 ft high, read from photos
Ceiling heights 9 ft (10 ft in kitchen 108) until confirmed
Upper kitchen cabinets the same length as the base cabinets
Priority 2 and 3 quantities are rough and will be measured on site before the final price
clarifications: Priority 2 and Priority 3 are priced as separate add-on prices so the client can choose
